title: backend-skeleton per-feature contract (meta-schema)
description: Validates the SHAPE of specs/<feature_id>/contracts/<feature_id>.schema.json itself -- not a payload. See contracts/validate.mjs for payload validation against a specific operation inside a contract that already passed this meta-schema.

sourceSecuritySchemes.description: A7: components.securitySchemes entries copied verbatim from a real source document (--openapi-file), restricted to schemes actually referenced by at least one operation's copied sourceSecurity requirement anywhere in this contract. Omitted entirely when openapi reconciliation never resolved any security requirement.

requestBodySchema.description: A2: the operation's request body projected from a real OpenAPI 3.1 document, fully inlined (no $ref) -- see contracts/openapi.mjs's inlineSchema(). Present only when reconciliation matched/adopted this operation AND its application/json schema resolved; omitted otherwise. Not deeply validated as 'is this a valid JSON Schema' here -- that would need a schema-of-schemas, out of scope.

responseSchema.description: A3: all documented 2xx application/json response schemas for this operation, fully inlined (no $ref); an anyOf union when 2+ distinct shapes are documented. Present only when matched/adopted AND at least one resolved.

errorSchema.description: A3: all documented 4xx/5xx application/json response schemas for this operation, fully inlined (no $ref); an anyOf union when 2+ distinct shapes are documented. Present only when matched/adopted AND at least one resolved.

sourceParameters.description: A7: non-path (query/header/cookie) parameters copied verbatim from a real source document's operation.parameters[], with `schema` resolved through inlineSchema(). Present only when matched/adopted AND the source document declared at least one such parameter that could be copied (a parameter whose own schema failed to resolve is still included here, just without a `schema` key).

sourceSecurity.description: A7: the operation's OpenAPI Security Requirement array, copied verbatim from the source document -- including a literal [] (a genuine positive claim of 'no auth required'). Present only when the source document declared `security` for this exact operation AND every scheme it names resolved against components.securitySchemes.

sourceSummary.description: A7: the operation's `summary` string, copied verbatim from the source document. Present only when the source document set one -- never synthesized from operationId or module names.

sourceTags.description: A7: the operation's `tags` array, copied verbatim from the source document. Present only when the source document set at least one.

sourceResponses.description: A8: per-status HTTP responses copied from a real source document, keyed by the document's own literal status key (a literal code, a range key like "2XX", or "default") -- never re-bucketed. Additive to responseSchema/errorSchema above, never replacing them; contracts/validate.mjs does not read this field. Present only when matched/adopted AND both the response and error union projections resolved cleanly (or had nothing to project) for this operation.

sourceRequestBody.description: A8: the request body's non-application/json media types (e.g. multipart/form-data), copied from a real source document. `content` never carries an "application/json" key -- that stays requestBodySchema above, the one representation of that one fact.

warnings.description: A5: structured, not bare strings -- see contracts/completeness.mjs's WARNING_CODES for the known code table.

completeness.description: A5: derived from operations/warnings alone, independent of any recorded waiver -- see contracts/completeness.mjs's classifyContract().
